column1: # Eukore's own marker loci (eukore/markers.py; since 2026-11-07): classic phylogenetic and barcode genes that are not
# BUSCOs (their OrthoDB groups are single-copy in few species: docs/loci.md). Each is defined by KEGG KOfam profiles of
# the target ortholog and of its paralogs (decoys: a region whose best profile is a decoy's is not the marker); its
# query proteins are the eukaryote proteins the profiles assign to the target, of Swiss-Prot and of NCBI's protein
# database (its Entrez query `ncbi`: RefSeq's of every eukaryote, GenBank's of the protists; names only gather them).
# locus: the package's name of it (no "_"); targets, decoys: KOfam KOs; kind: clean (an ortholog distinct from its old
# paralogs) or family (a multigene family: its best copy is taken).
